characters.look_en: a young woman with long straight black hair and a beige trench coat

characters.name: ソウタ
characters.look_ja: 茶髪の短髪、紺のスーツ、黒い傘
characters.look_en: a young man with short brown hair, a navy suit and a black umbrella

panels.beat_ja: 駅前で急な雨。立ち止まる
panels.background_en: A busy station entrance in sudden heavy rain, people hurrying with umbrellas, wet pavement reflecting lights

cast.acting_en: standing under the station roof, looking up at the rain in dismay

panels.beat_ja: カバンを探しても傘がない
panels.background_en: The station entrance with rain falling behind

cast.acting_en: digging through her handbag with a worried face

panels.beat_ja: 隣の男性が傘を差し出す
panels.background_en: The station entrance with rain falling behind

cast.acting_en: holding out his closed black umbrella toward her with a shy smile
blushing with wide eyes, hand near her mouth

panels.beat_ja: 傘に入れてもらい、歩き出そうとする（引き）
panels.background_en: Stepping out from the station roof into the rain

cast.acting_en: about to open the umbrella with a confident face
standing close beside him, nodding shyly
holding up an opened umbrella full of big holes, frozen in shock
cast.acting_ja: 穴だらけの傘に固まる

cast.acting_en: soaking wet, hair dripping, staring blankly
soaking wet, still holding the broken umbrella
cast.acting_ja: 壊れた傘を持ったまま

cast.acting_en: looking at her with an apologetic, embarrassed face
bursting into laughter, covering her mouth

panels.beat_ja: 二人で笑いながら雨の中を走る
panels.background_en: A rainy city street at dusk with glowing shop lights and splashing puddles

cast.acting_en: running and laughing, holding the broken umbrella over his head
